inputs.label: Star Wars: TIE Fighter Special Edition (Steam)
inputs.help: Your installed Steam copy. qgp copies its collectors_cd and remastered folders.

steps.why: The guide has the user allow access to all files when the app asks.

steps.text: Open OpenTIE VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases. Steam app ID left out because it is not confirmed here. detect lists the two folders the guide names; no file inside them is documented. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest. Optional: the X-Wing Alliance folder in /sdcard/OpenXWA, or FLIGHTMODELS/TIECOCKPIT.OPT in /sdcard/OpenTIE/, adds the TIE Defender and Missile Boat cockpits; not modelled. The APK is signed with a debug key, so a later properly signed release may need an uninstall.
